directive: Answer only from evidence about the actual user. Distinguish the user from clients, relatives and quoted or fictional speakers. A question or shopping interest does not establish ownership. Missing evidence means unknown, not that something does not exist. Preserve explicit negatives and genuine user assertions. Entity co-occurrence does not establish identity. Do not invent personal facts. Keep the answer brief.
